name: AnyDress AI Virtual Try-On
author: anydress

sections.description:
AnyDress AI Virtual Try-On revolutionizes your WooCommerce store by allowing shoppers to visually “try on” your clothing using artificial intelligence. Increase conversion rates, boost buyer confidence, and reduce return rates by letting customers see exactly how your garments will look on their own bodies.

Additionally, store owners can use the Virtual Photoshoot dashboard to generate professional, studio-quality catalog images of their garments using AI models or ghost mannequins, saving thousands of dollars on physical photography.

Features

  • Shopper Virtual Try-On: Adds a customizable “Try It On” button to WooCommerce product pages.
  • Digital Mannequin: Logged-in shoppers can securely save their face and body photos for 1-click try-ons across your whole store.
  • Admin Virtual Photoshoot: Instantly generate new product catalog images using WooCommerce products or raw garment uploads.
  • AI Models & Ghost Mannequins: Choose to use the original model, upload your own, generate a random AI model, or create invisible ghost mannequins.
  • Custom Backgrounds: Describe any scene or background to place your models in.
  • Magic Edit: Alter the pose, aspect ratio, resolution, and photography style of your generated images.
  • Usage Controls: Set daily try-on limits to protect your API budget.
  • Privacy-First Design: Built-in legal consent checkboxes for both shoppers and admins, ensuring no data is sent to the AI engine without explicit user agreement.

External Services

This plugin relies on the AnyDress AI SaaS platform (https://anydress.ai) to process and generate images. An active AnyDress AI API key is required to use this plugin.

  • What the service is used for: The AnyDress AI API provides the artificial intelligence engine required to “clothe” a digital mannequin with a product image and to generate studio-quality catalog photoshoots.
  • What data is sent and when:
    1. Shopper Try-On: Only after a logged-in user gives explicit consent via a checkbox, their uploaded photos (Face/Body) and the WooCommerce product image are converted to Base64 and sent to the AnyDress AI endpoint.
    2. Admin Photoshoot: Only after the administrator confirms rights to the images, the selected garment and model photos are sent to the API.
    3. Verification: The store domain and license key are sent to verify subscription status and usage limits.
  • Data Handling & Privacy: Images are processed in secure server memory to generate the result and are immediately discarded by the API upon completion. User data is confidential and never used to train AI models.
  • Terms & Privacy Links:
    • Terms of Service: https://anydress.ai/terms-of-service/
    • Privacy Policy: https://anydress.ai/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the anydress-ai-virtual-try-on folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to AnyDress AI Settings in your WordPress dashboard.
  5. Enter your AnyDress API License Key and click “Save & Verify Key”.
  6. Customize your button appearance and set your daily shopper limits.
  7. Add the Virtual Try-On Feature Privacy Policy from WP Dashboard -> Settings -> Privacy -> Policy Guide -> Policies -> AnyDress AI Virtual Try-On to your existing Privacy Policy page.
sections.faq:
Do I need an AnyDress AI account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need an active API License Key from AnyDress AI to connect your WooCommerce store to the AI generation engine.

Where are shopper photos saved?

Shopper photos are securely saved in a hidden, local folder on your own WordPress server (wp-content/uploads/anydress-mannequins/). To protect privacy and save disk space, a cron job automatically deletes shopper photos 7 days after upload. Shoppers can also manually delete their data at any time via the “Digital Mannequin” tab in their My Account page.

Does this work with any theme?

Yes! The plugin hooks directly into standard WooCommerce templates. The “Try It On” button will automatically appear next to your “Add to Cart” button.
